recipes.intent: steady kick for house or techno.
recipes.notes: `bd*4` is four kicks per cycle. Add a hat in recipe 2.

recipes.title: Offbeat hat
recipes.intent: open-hat feel between kicks.
recipes.notes: `~` rests shift the hat to the offbeats.
recipes.error: needs a sample bank, none loaded in the headless renderer: [webaudio] error: sound RolandTR808_hh not found! Is it loaded?

recipes.title: Euclid groove
recipes.intent: non-straight rhythm from euclidean distribution.
recipes.notes: `(beats,segments,rotation)`. Source: https://strudel.cc/learn/mini-notation/
recipes.error: needs a sample bank, none loaded in the headless renderer: [webaudio] error: sound RolandTR909_bd not found! Is it loaded?

recipes.title: Reese-style detuned bass
recipes.intent: thick, moving bass from two detuned saws.
recipes.code:
$: stack(
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth"),
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth").add(note(0.12))
).hpf(30).lpf(400).lpq(8).attack(0.005).gain(0.38)
recipes.notes: the `add(note(0.12))` detune is UNVERIFIED (it is a semitone offset via documented `add`). A true supersaw is `s("supersaw")`, which appears in a documented example. Keep `lpq` below about 15 for stability (judgement, UNVERIFIED).
recipes.expr:
stack(
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth"),
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth").add(note(0.12))
).hpf(30).lpf(400).lpq(8).attack(0.005).gain(0.38)

recipes.title: Sub bass
recipes.intent: clean low sine under the kick.
recipes.notes: low-pass keeps it sub. Remove the filter for purer sine.

recipes.title: Pad swell
recipes.intent: slow-attack chord pad with a room tail.
recipes.notes: `attack`/`release` in seconds, `roomsize` 0 to 10.

recipes.title: Filter sweep build
recipes.intent: rising cutoff on a sawtooth loop, over bars.
recipes.notes: `sine.slow(8).range(200,4000)` is a signal on `lpf`. Cutoff is 0 to 20000 Hz.

recipes.title: Riser
recipes.intent: noise rising in pitch and brightness into a drop.
recipes.notes: `saw.slow(8)` runs 0 to 1 over 8 cycles, so the riser fades in.

recipes.title: Breakdown/drop arrangement over bars
recipes.intent: sections of 8 cycles: pad, drums, then both.
recipes.notes: `arrange([cycles, pattern], ...)` syntax is verified from the Strudel FAQ mirror (https://warm.strudel.cc/learn/faq). Confirm on strudel.cc. `setcpm(BPM/4)` for 4/4.

recipes.title: Half-time
recipes.intent: backbeat on beat 3 at half speed.
recipes.notes: one kick and one snare per cycle; cycle length is one bar at the set tempo. Use `.slow(2)` on the hat to thin it.
recipes.error: needs a sample bank, none loaded in the headless renderer: [webaudio] error: sound RolandTR808_bd not found! Is it loaded?

recipes.title: Call-and-response
recipes.intent: phrase, then answer in the next cycle.
recipes.code:
$: note("<[c4 e4 g4 e4] ~>").s("triangle").room(0.3)
$: note("<~ [g4 a4 b4 c5]>").s("square").gain(0.5)
recipes.notes: alternation `< >` swaps the phrase and answer each cycle.
recipes.expr:
stack(
  note("<[c4 e4 g4 e4] ~>").s("triangle").room(0.3),
  note("<~ [g4 a4 b4 c5]>").s("square").gain(0.5)
)

recipes.title: Minor motif
recipes.intent: short repeating melody in A minor.
recipes.notes: `scale("A:minor")` uses root:scale syntax from the tonal page. Numbers index the scale.

recipes.title: Chord stabs
recipes.intent: short plucked chords on each beat pair.
recipes.notes: `^` marks major seventh. `decay` and `sustain(0)` cut each chord short.

recipes.title: Sidechain pump
recipes.intent: pad ducks under the kick.
recipes.notes: the pattern on `orbit(2)` is the one that ducks. Structure taken from the duck section of https://strudel.cc/learn/effects/. Ducked layer is listed first: otherwise superdough reports 'duck target orbit 2 does not exist'. The offline renderer also logs a harmless t=0 stop-time warning for ducking (ignored by the verifier).
recipes.error: needs a sample bank, none loaded in the headless renderer: [webaudio] error: sound bd not found! Is it loaded?

recipes.title: Fade out
recipes.intent: volume steps down to silence over the last bars.
recipes.notes: `gain` accepts a pattern, so each cycle drops one step. Use `saw.range(1,0).slow(8)` for a smooth fade (signal form documented on https://strudel.cc/learn/signals/).

recipes.title: Synth kick (no samples)
recipes.intent: Four low thumps from a sine with a falling pitch, no sample bank needed.
recipes.notes: Pitch envelope drops 24 semitones in 0.08 s; decay cuts the tail. Same idea as the kick mapping in docs/STRUDEL_PORT.md. Tuned to G1 (49 Hz) so the body sits above the 30 Hz high-pass.

recipes.title: Noise tick on the offbeats
recipes.intent: Short filtered noise between the beats.
recipes.notes: `white` is the built-in noise source. hpf keeps only the top; decay/sustain(0) make it short.

recipes.title: Noise backbeat
recipes.intent: One short noise burst on beat 2 of each bar, band-limited.
recipes.notes: Two-step bar, so the burst lands on the second half (a half-time feel).

recipes.title: Euclid low pulse
recipes.intent: Three pulses spread over eight steps, uneven on purpose.
recipes.notes: `(beats,segments)` euclidean mini-notation.

recipes.title: Syncopated bass line
recipes.intent: Bass that leaves gaps and lands off the beat.
recipes.notes: Rests (`~`) make the groove; lower the lpf for darker.

recipes.title: Wide detuned pad
recipes.intent: Slow chord pad with stereo spread from a detuned saw stack.
recipes.notes: `s("supersaw")` is in a documented example; `unison`, `detune`, `spread` come from docs/STRUDEL_PORT.md (not on the fetched official pages).

recipes.title: Short pluck line
recipes.intent: Plucked notes: a filter envelope closes quickly on each note.
recipes.notes: `lpenv` is the filter envelope depth; lpa/lpd its attack/decay.

recipes.title: Minor arpeggio
recipes.intent: Rising and falling arpeggio in A minor, twice per cycle.
recipes.notes: Scale degrees via `scale("A:minor")`.

recipes.title: Four-chord progression
recipes.intent: Am7 - Fmaj7 - C - G, one chord per cycle, voiced automatically.
recipes.notes: `^` = major seventh. `voicing()` picks chord tones near a default anchor.

recipes.title: Root-following bass
recipes.intent: Bass that plays the root of each chord, two hits per cycle.
recipes.notes: Match the roots to the chord recipe above.

recipes.title: Echo tail
recipes.intent: A sparse line with repeating echoes.
recipes.notes: delay = send level, delaytime in seconds, feedback 0 to 1 (below 1).

recipes.title: Reversed copy on the right
recipes.intent: Wide image: original left, reversed pattern right.
recipes.notes: `jux` applies a function to the right channel only. `rev` appears in a jux example only.

recipes.title: Big reverb splash
recipes.intent: A single short note blooming into a long room.
recipes.notes: roomsize 0 to 10.

recipes.title: Dry and tight
recipes.intent: No reverb, short notes, close and intimate.
recipes.notes: Contrast with the big reverb recipe.

recipes.title: Phaser movement
recipes.intent: Slow swirling motion on a held saw.
recipes.notes: phaser = speed; depth 0 to 1.

recipes.title: Tremolo shimmer
recipes.intent: Amplitude wobble on a chord.
recipes.notes: tremolo speed in Hz; tremolodepth amount; tremoloshape("sine") keeps the wobble smooth (the default shape is a ramp, which clicks).

recipes.title: Vowel formant colour
recipes.intent: Saw notes shaped like vowel sounds, a different vowel each cycle.
recipes.code: $: note("c3 eb3 g3 eb3").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o>").gain(0.5)
recipes.notes: `vowel` is a formant filter, not a sampled voice.
recipes.expr: note("c3 eb3 g3 eb3").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o>").gain(0.5)

recipes.title: FM bell
recipes.intent: Metallic bell tones from frequency modulation.
recipes.notes: fm = modulation index, fmh = harmonicity ratio.

recipes.title: Lo-fi crunch
recipes.intent: Bit and sample-rate reduction for a degraded, gritty tone.
recipes.notes: crush 1 to 16 bits (lower = rougher); coarse divides the sample rate.

recipes.title: Drifting filter
recipes.intent: Cutoff wanders smoothly by itself.
recipes.notes: perlin = smooth noise 0..1; `.range` scales it. The cutoff is read once per note.

recipes.title: Crescendo
recipes.intent: Volume rises over eight cycles.
recipes.notes: saw ramps 0 to 1 each period.

recipes.title: Accent pattern
recipes.intent: Strong-weak-medium-weak pulse on a bass note.
recipes.notes: velocity multiplies gain, 0 to 1.

recipes.title: Sidechain pump (synth)
recipes.intent: Pad ducks under a synth kick.
recipes.notes: The pattern on orbit 2 is the one that ducks. Ducked layer is listed first: otherwise superdough reports 'duck target orbit 2 does not exist'. The offline renderer also logs a harmless t=0 stop-time warning for ducking (ignored by the verifier).

recipes.title: Build and drop sections
recipes.intent: Pad alone, then pulse and pad, then everything, 4 cycles each.
recipes.notes: `arrange([cycles, pattern], ...)` from the FAQ mirror. Not stackable in the compose page (it has top-level statements).

recipes.title: Layers entering one by one
recipes.intent: Three layers join at bars 1, 3 and 5 using masks.
recipes.notes: `mask` with a `<>` pattern switches a layer on/off per cycle (used by docs/STRUDEL_PORT.md; not on the fetched official pages).

recipes.title: Intro with an opening filter
recipes.intent: Cutoff steps up each cycle to reveal the loop.
recipes.notes: A `<>` list on `lpf` is one value per cycle.

recipes.title: Random thinning
recipes.intent: Sixteenth ticks with random gaps; differs each cycle.
recipes.notes: `?` removes events at random (50%); `?0.2` removes fewer.

recipes.title: Polymeter
recipes.intent: Three-note and four-note lines share one pulse, drifting against each other.

recipes.title: Drop bar before the hook
recipes.intent: Drums play three bars and drop out for the fourth, so the hook lands on an empty bar's pickup.
recipes.notes: Plain Strudel uses .mask("<1 1 1 0>"); with hooks the same form is the gate atom hh.dropBar (tagged("drums").mute(atoms.hh.dropBar)).

recipes.title: Drop the beat on beat 4
recipes.intent: Every 4th bar the drums stop for the last beat: a gap that pulls into the next section.
recipes.notes: Plain Strudel masks the last quarter of every 4th bar; with hooks it is the gate atom hh.lastBeat (bar.beat points, 20.4b..21b).

recipes.title: Beat switch
recipes.intent: Two bars boom-bap, then the same harmony over a trap kit: the beat switches, the song does not.
recipes.notes: Plain Strudel alternates kits with masks; with hooks: hooks.bind("kick", "bbKick", "<29b") and hooks.bind("kick", "knock808", atoms.hh.switch).
